_comment: Copy to port-info.json and fill in. That file is gitignored: this repo is public and these values let someone attempt to steal the number. Sources for every field are in docs/PORTING.md.
pin: GoDaddy port-out email, 'Conversations Port Out Request Complete'
account_number: GoDaddy customer number, on any renewal receipt
customer_name: MUST match the losing carrier CSR exactly, not your own name unless Twilio says otherwise
